rationale: Automatic fixed FP64 reuse follows actual energy/density/screening goals at least 1e-6/1e-4/1e-10 and the 192-AO amortization floor, never the frontend Standard/Fast label, dtype or budget-presence flags. Explicit TargetErrorBudget is admitted for either preset; equal budgets and solver ceilings select the same qualified execution. Preserve incumbent relaxed-target reuse instead of withdrawing Fast optimization or forcing a target-independent strict default. Tighter targets and smaller owners retain opt-in. The retained 2026-11-13 always-on strict-target trial is a rejected historical candidate, not a current Standard speedup claim. Explicit 0 disables reuse and 1 cannot bypass model, precision, lifetime or resource admission. Strict arithmetic, screening, convergence and full-density closure are unchanged. Five FP64 matrices and one scalar remain charged and optional, with bounded allocation fallback and force-pressure retirement.
